rationale: Addresses cluster [validate_failed::workflow-section] (t05-collection): validation passed with 0 warnings despite provenance being entirely missing from the pack. The agent relied on --strict validation as a completeness gate, but E14/E15 only validates that existing provenance keys point at real records — it does NOT flag provenance absence. This edit makes that validator blind-spot explicit so the agent knows to manually verify provenance presence rather than trusting a green validation result.
expected_effect: The agent will no longer treat a passing `--strict` validation as sufficient evidence that provenance is present. After validation passes, it will perform a manual provenance check on all records before considering the pack complete, closing the gap that allowed t05-collection to pass validation with zero provenance entries.
regression_risk: Very low — only the E14/E15 row is modified by appending a caveat clause. All other rows (E1-E13, W1-W6) remain verbatim. The caveat is factually accurate (the validator does not flag missing provenance) and does not alter any existing rule's enforcement semantics.
